title: 游戏内容与物品多样性不足
description: 游戏内物品多样性不足，食物和毒品种类均有限。
evidence: There are only 3 food brands, cheap af preserfved food with like 10 variations of flavout and two street vendors, who offer 3 dishes each.
game has illegal station with "drug seller" but no drugs except for 4 types of pills (medical), 3 types of injections (medical) and basically thats it.

Few tools - screwdriver, hacksaw, their better versions angle grinder and power drill, small welder, soldering tool and their better alternative, laser tool. And crowbar. Could really use a few more brands/variations of tools, so that there are diffrent brands of power drill for example, even if its just 2 or 3.

evidence_items.quote: There are only 3 food brands, cheap af preserfved food with like 10 variations of flavout and two street vendors, who offer 3 dishes each.
evidence_items.description: 食物种类少，只有3个品牌和少量菜品
evidence_items.quote_zh: 只有3个食品品牌，便宜得要命的保存食品大约有10种口味变化，还有两个街头小贩，每人提供3道菜。

evidence_items.quote: game has illegal station with "drug seller" but no drugs except for 4 types of pills (medical), 3 types of injections (medical) and basically thats it.
evidence_items.description: 非法空间站有毒品贩子但只有几种医疗药丸和注射剂
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏里有个非法空间站，里面有“毒品贩子”，但除了4种药片（医疗用）、3种注射剂（医疗用）之外基本就没有毒品了，差不多就这些。

evidence_items.quote: Few tools - screwdriver, hacksaw, their better versions angle grinder and power drill, small welder, soldering tool and their better alternative, laser tool. And crowbar. Could really use a few more brands/variations of tools, so that there are diffrent brands of power drill for example, even if its just 2 or 3.
evidence_items.description: 工具种类少，缺乏品牌和变体
evidence_items.quote_zh: 工具很少——螺丝刀、钢锯、它们更好的版本角磨机和电钻、小型焊机、焊接工具及其更好的替代品激光工具。还有撬棍。真的可以多用几个品牌/变体的工具，比如电钻能有不同品牌，哪怕只有两三个也好。
